items.q: Can I see the product before subscribing?
items.a: Yes. We walk you through a demo on a real account of your choice: you see the dossier Bellum produces, the contacts it finds and the action plan it proposes, before any decision.

What costs something to produce: analysing an account (8 credits), refreshing a dossier (4, or 1 for a single dimension) and enriching a contact (1 credit). An enrichment that finds no details is not charged. Everything else — copilot, messages, exports, sharing, daily monitoring — is included.

items.q: Can I change plan at any time?
items.a: Yes. Growth carries no commitment and can be cancelled at any time. Annual billing saves you 20%.

items.q: What's the difference between the plans?
items.a: Free is the demo: you browse simulated dossiers, with no account and no enrichment. Growth is the whole product for one rep — 250 credits a month, every feature open, no exception. Enterprise starts at the second user: pooled credits, manager oversight and guided rollout, on quote.
